nodes.label: Verified — SMS, IVR, or we raise it?

nodes.label: SMS steps + anything else?

config.prompt: sir to request paper rolls, you need to send an SMS in the following format: Type R-O-L-L, followed by a space, your M-I-D number, another space, and the required quantity. Please make sure to add a zero before your M-I-D number. Then, send the SMS to five, seven, five, seven, five, eight. Before sending, please double-check that you've entered the correct M-I-D number and required quantity. Sir is there anything else I can help you with today?

textByLanguage.en: sir to request paper rolls, you need to send an SMS in the following format: Type R-O-L-L, followed by a space, your M-I-D number, another space, and the required quantity. Please make sure to add a zero before your M-I-D number. Then, send the SMS to five, seven, five, seven, five, eight. Before sending, please double-check that you've entered the correct M-I-D number and required quantity. Sir is there anything else I can help you with today?
textByLanguage.hi: sir paper rolls request करने के लिए आपको एक SMS भेजना होगा। SMS में पहले आर, ओ, एल, एल लिखें, फिर space देकर अपना M-I-D number और उसके बाद required quantity enter करें। ध्यान रखें, M-I-D number से पहले zero जरूर लगाएं। इसके बाद ये SMS five, seven, five, seven, five, eight पर भेज दें। SMS भेजने से पहले एक बार confirm कर लें कि आपने सही M-I-D number और required quantity enter की है। सर क्या मैं आज आपकी किसी और चीज़ में मदद कर सकता हूँ?

nodes.label: IVR steps + anything else?

config.prompt: sir, you can place a paper roll request through our I-V-R service by following these steps. Step one. Call one eight six zero, two three three two, three three two. Or, call zero two two, four zero four two, six zero six zero. Step two. Select your preferred language. Step three. Enter your Terminal I-D. Step four. Press two to select the paper roll request option. Step five. Select the required quantity by pressing any number from one to nine. Step six. Enter any valid ten-digit mobile number and press the hash key. Once the process is completed, your paper roll request will be registered. The docket number will be sent to the mobile number you entered. Sir is there anything else I can help you with today?

textByLanguage.en: sir, you can place a paper roll request through our I-V-R service by following these steps. Step one. Call one eight six zero, two three three two, three three two. Or, call zero two two, four zero four two, six zero six zero. Step two. Select your preferred language. Step three. Enter your Terminal I-D. Step four. Press two to select the paper roll request option. Step five. Select the required quantity by pressing any number from one to nine. Step six. Enter any valid ten-digit mobile number and press the hash key. Once the process is completed, your paper roll request will be registered. The docket number will be sent to the mobile number you entered. Sir is there anything else I can help you with today?
textByLanguage.hi: आप paper roll की request हमारी I-V-R service के जरिए भी कर सकते हैं। इसके लिए ये steps follow कीजिए। Step one. One eight six zero, two three three two, three three two पर call कीजिए। या फिर zero two two, four zero four two, six zero six zero पर call कीजिए। Step two. अपनी preferred language select कीजिए। Step three. अपना Terminal I-D enter कीजिए। Step four. Paper roll request का option select करने के लिए two press कीजिए। Step five. जितने paper rolls चाहिए, उनकी quantity select करने के लिए one से nine के बीच कोई भी number press कीजिए। Step six. कोई भी valid ten-digit mobile number enter कीजिए और hash key press कीजिए। Process complete होने के बाद आपकी paper roll request register हो जाएगी। आपका docket number आपके दिए गए mobile number पर भेज दिया जाएगा। सर क्या मैं आज आपकी किसी और चीज़ में मदद कर सकता हूँ?

nodes.label: Open the back panel — battery normal, hot, swollen or damaged?

config.prompt: Now, kindly open the back panel of the terminal and check the battery condition. Please tell me, is the battery normal, or is it overheating, swollen, or showing any visible damage?

textByLanguage.en: Now, kindly open the back panel of the terminal and check the battery condition. Please tell me, is the battery normal, or is it overheating, swollen, or showing any visible damage?

nodes.label: Battery fine: clean the contacts, reconnect, switch on — done?

config.prompt: Thank you for confirming. Please carefully remove the battery and gently clean the battery contacts using a dry, soft cloth. Once done, reconnect the battery properly and close the back panel. Now, kindly switch on the terminal and let me know once you've completed these steps.

textByLanguage.en: Thank you for confirming. Please carefully remove the battery and gently clean the battery contacts using a dry, soft cloth. Once done, reconnect the battery properly and close the back panel. Now, kindly switch on the terminal and let me know once you've completed these steps.
textByLanguage.hi: Confirm करने के लिए धन्यवाद। कृपया battery को सावधानी से निकालें और उसके contacts को एक सूखे और मुलायम कपड़े से धीरे-धीरे साफ करें। इसके बाद, battery को सही तरीके से दोबारा connect करें और back panel बंद कर दें। अब terminal को switch on कीजिए। ये steps पूरे हो जाने पर कृपया मुझे बताइए।

nodes.label: Battery charge: adapter connected to socket and terminal?

config.prompt: Now let's check the charging adapter. First, please ensure that the adapter is properly connected to both the power socket and the terminal. Please let me know once it's done.

textByLanguage.en: Now let's check the charging adapter. First, please ensure that the adapter is properly connected to both the power socket and the terminal. Please let me know once it's done.
textByLanguage.hi: अब हम charging adapter check करते हैं। सबसे पहले, कृपया ensure कीजिए कि adapter power socket और terminal, दोनों से properly connected है। ये हो जाए तो मुझे बताइए।

nodes.label: Battery damaged: safety advice + service ticket — may I proceed?

config.prompt: Sir, for your safety, please do not remove, reconnect, or charge the damaged battery. Also, please do not continue using the terminal. Kindly keep the terminal switched off. We will raise a service ticket and arrange an engineer visit for battery replacement. To schedule the field engineer's visit, I need to confirm a few details. May I proceed?

textByLanguage.en: Sir, for your safety, please do not remove, reconnect, or charge the damaged battery. Also, please do not continue using the terminal. Kindly keep the terminal switched off. We will raise a service ticket and arrange an engineer visit for battery replacement. To schedule the field engineer's visit, I need to confirm a few details. May I proceed?
textByLanguage.hi: सर, आपकी safety को ध्यान में रखते हुए, कृपया damaged battery को न निकालें, दोबारा connect न करें और न ही charge करें। साथ ही, terminal का इस्तेमाल भी न करें। कृपया terminal को switched off ही रखें। हम battery replacement के लिए एक service ticket raise करेंगे और engineer की visit arrange करेंगे। Field engineer की visit schedule करने के लिए मुझे आपसे कुछ details confirm करनी होंगी। क्या मैं आगे बढ़ूँ?
